skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Translate specialized texts accurately across various types (reports, presentations, articles, advertisements, etc.)
Structure text to identify themes, logical development, and ensure faithful translation while maintaining original intent
Evaluate translation quality using appropriate tools and techniques
Assess the quality of translation work and products independently
Create a personal terminology database and maintain it throughout the course
Utilize technology to support translation tasks in various operational contexts
Develop teamwork skills and leadership within groups
Foster professional ethics in translation work
